page: Microsoft Azure L64as_v5 is a member of the Lasv5 server family, utilizing dedicated AMD processors built on the x86_64 architecture. This virtualized instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 64 dedicated vCPUs alongside 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this server type is its massive local storage capacity, providing 15,359 GB of local storage. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external disk options. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high density of local storage and memory relative to the 64 dedicated vCPUs, the L64as_v5 offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large-scale local data caching and high-throughput database operations. The absence of a GPU limits its utility for hardware-accelerated machine learning, but the hardware profile is well-suited for large relational databases, NoSQL data stores, big data analytics, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
description: Microsoft Azure L64as_v5 is a storage-optimized and memory-optimized virtual machine from the Lasv5 family, powered by dedicated AMD processors on the x86_64 architecture. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 8.0 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware highlight is its substantial local storage capacity of 15,359 GB, combined with Premium Storage compatibility. With no integrated GPUs, this server is designed for data-intensive workloads rather than graphical acceleration. The high storage-to-vCPU ratio and large memory footprint make the L64as_v5 highly efficient for hosting large databases, big data analytics, and enterprise applications requiring high-capacity local data caching.
